feed.headline: Analysis: Trump's shock Russia deal highlights mounting pressure to curb fuel prices
feed.ai: The US president hopes to ease his party's pain before next month's midterm elections, writes the BBC's North America correspondent.

feed.headline: Senators Urge Trump to Reverse Diesel Deal With Putin
feed.ai: A bipartisan group of 12 senators called on the president to drop his decision to ease sanctions on Russia’s exports of diesel fuel, saying the deal would help Moscow continue the war in Ukraine.

feed.headline: Germany puts Ukrainian on trial accused of blowing up Nord Stream pipelines
feed.ai: Four years after the attacks, Serhii Kuznetsov appears in court accused of a plot to destroy Russia's gas pipelines to Germany.

feed.headline: Turkish police raid opposition TV station, halting live broadcasts
feed.ai: It is the latest in a series of crackdowns on media critical of the Turkish president and his government.

feed.headline: Russia arrests Japanese journalist on spying charges
feed.ai: The Hokkaido Shimbun journalist is accused of collecting information on Moscow's defence capabilities for Tokyo.

feed.headline: Six Ukrainian energy sites hit by Russia since Trump announced ceasefire, Zelensky says
feed.ai: Despite the US president announcing energy infrastructure would not be targeted strikes have continued, Ukraine says.

feed.headline: Why the prime minister wants to talk about Brexit again
feed.ai: For the first time since the UK left the EU, we have a prime minister who will "unflinchingly" debate Brexit, says the BBC's political editor Chris Mason.

feed.headline: Nord Stream trial: How German police followed the evidence - to Ukraine
feed.ai: After four years, a Ukrainian man is set to stand trial in Hamburg accused of sabotaging the Nord Stream pipelines.

feed.headline: Watch: What could Trump's energy ceasefire mean for Ukraine?
feed.ai: The BBC's Dan Johnson reports from Kyiv, where Ukrainians face another winter with electricity outages.

feed.headline: Zelensky to Visit U.K. as Ukraine Presses Allies on Intelligence Sharing
feed.ai: President Volodymyr Zelensky said Ukraine received “no early warning from our partners” about a Russian attack. President Trump has said Washington is still “sharing intel.”

feed.headline: ‘Honey Please’: The Steep Rise and Sudden Fall of Kimberly Guilfoyle.
feed.ai: President Trump cut her loose after damaging news reports about her tenure as ambassador to Greece. Once a prominent Trump insider, she suggested she will now fight to defend her reputation.

feed.headline: Trump Hands Victories to Putin, Who Offers More War in Return
feed.ai: Russia has reaped a diesel deal and an increase in U.S. pressure on Ukraine as President Trump’s political needs align with his longstanding inclinations toward Russia.
